LICENSE.txt and the two stm32_bluepill_wasm artifacts come unchanged from this release.
worker.js is the lab's local adapter. It loads the WASM from the same origin and
runs uploaded firmware inside a dedicated worker that the lab can terminate.
The upstream CLI, networking servers and package dependencies are excluded.
